card.name: Stillbirth and placenta pregnancy terms
card.fires_on: The end of 'stillborn' or 'stillbirth' (the part after 'still'), and similar pregnancy words such as 'labor' and the start of 'placenta', in pregnancy-risk sections of drug labels.

modes.label: Stillbirth
modes.description: The 'born' or 'birth' part right after 'still' when pregnancy loss is listed as a risk.
modes.example: can cause pregnancy loss or still<<birth>>. Exclude pregnancy in females

modes.label: Placenta and labor
modes.description: Start of 'placental' after 'crosses the', or 'labor' in labor and delivery statements.
modes.example: Thiazides cross the<< plac>>ental barrier and appear in cord blood.
